entry.definition: To formally tell someone information they need to know.
entry.example: Please notify the team if the meeting time changes.

image.brief: A meeting change notification reaching all affected colleagues.

review.notes: Proposed intact modern teaching unit, not a claim that the word lacks historical morphology. The history concerns making known from Latin notus. Splitting modern not + ify without a carefully explained Latin root would misleadingly present the English negative not. Keep the headword intact pending that decision. Source consultation was performed by an AI author; a qualified linguistic reviewer must decide whether this candidate is suitable for teaching. All review gates remain pending.
